why: A is a coherent Nordic set in pale ash, birch and white: a light wood desk, a full-width tall bookcase for the white wall, and a classic bentwood reading chair that suit the bright room. Its only weak spot is a hard wooden desk chair that may not be very comfortable. B mixes an industrial pipe desk, a honey-toned traditional office chair and an English-style grey armchair, and its narrow 40 cm bookcase holds few books, so it misses the light-wood Nordic brief and lacks a unified look.
